items.reason: Script got HTTP 401, but I opened the page myself and found the quote verbatim ('~70% of capital in real estate and the rest in startups, loans...'). The page also says 'We are not a VC.' This supports private_holding (real-estate-heavy group). Tier 2 and self_reported=true are correct.

The CzechCrunch article (12.9.2023) names Novira Capital as an investor in Smartlook's 2020 spin-off round (over CZK 80M) with a ~10% stake, so role and entity are supported. But this is a recap of the 2023 exit, and the deal itself is from 2020: outside the 24-month window (start 2024-10-11) and the 36-month dormant window.

The quote is on the page, but it says ~70% real estate with the rest in startups, loans and other investments. That supports a real-estate-heavy group, not 'real_estate_only' as the code says. The record's own note admits this. The page's 'We are not a VC' supports excluding it as not a VC.
